paragraphs: R' Chanina bar Shelda. See the entry R' Chanina bar Shalka.[^1]

notes.text: The heading has שלדא, Shelda; the target has שלקא, Shalka. These different consonantal forms are retained with conventional English vowels. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
